start.title: [TODO:fr] The Famine
start.text:
[TODO:fr] The promised land cracks under drought.
Flocks weaken. Sarah grows thin.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Trust God and wait for rain
[TODO:fr] Curse the dry sky
[TODO:fr] Turn south to Egypt at once

road_south.title: [TODO:fr] The Road South
road_south.text:
[TODO:fr] Egypt promises grain. Sarah walks beside you, silent.
The horizon shimmers.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Pray before each step forward
[TODO:fr] Push on without a word to God

fear_rises.title: [TODO:fr] A Cold Thought
fear_rises.text:
[TODO:fr] Egyptians may kill you to take your wife.
Fear coils tight inside your chest.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Plot a lie to save yourself
[TODO:fr] Trust God to guard you both
[TODO:fr] Turn back to the famine

the_lie.title: [TODO:fr] The Half-Truth
the_lie.text:
[TODO:fr] Sarah's eyes find yours. "Say you are my sister."
The words taste like ash.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Confess fear and speak truth
[TODO:fr] Make her agree to the lie

entering_egypt.title: [TODO:fr] The Gates of Egypt
entering_egypt.text:
[TODO:fr] The city teems. Eyes follow Sarah everywhere.
Whispers reach the palace.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Stay close and shield her
[TODO:fr] Step away to seem unrelated
[TODO:fr] Boast of the gifts you'll receive

officials_come.title: [TODO:fr] Pharaoh's Officials
officials_come.text:
[TODO:fr] An official arrives. "Pharaoh has heard of her beauty."
His smile is polite. Sharp.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Repeat the lie — "My sister"
[TODO:fr] Speak truth — "She is my wife"

sarah_taken.title: [TODO:fr] Alone
sarah_taken.text:
[TODO:fr] They lead Sarah toward the palace.
The tent is suddenly unbearably quiet.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Fall to your knees and cry to God
[TODO:fr] Sit numb and count your losses

gifts_arrive.title: [TODO:fr] The Price of Silence
gifts_arrive.text:
[TODO:fr] Sheep, gold, servants — Pharaoh's payment.
Each gift feels like a nail.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Accept them, hide the shame
[TODO:fr] Refuse them and beg God to act
[TODO:fr] Send them back to Pharaoh

plagues.title: [TODO:fr] God Strikes
plagues.text:
[TODO:fr] Sickness sweeps through Pharaoh's house.
No healer can name its cause.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Know that God has not forgotten
[TODO:fr] Fear what God will do to you

confronted.title: [TODO:fr] The Reckoning
confronted.text:
[TODO:fr] Pharaoh's voice shakes. "Why did you do this?
Why did you say 'my sister'?"

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Make excuses for your fear
[TODO:fr] Bow your head — no defense
[TODO:fr] Blame the famine for it all

expelled.title: [TODO:fr] Sent Away
expelled.text:
[TODO:fr] "Take your wife. Take it all. Go."
Guards walk you to the border.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Walk ahead, too ashamed to look
[TODO:fr] Reach for Sarah's hand in silence

altar.title: [TODO:fr] The Altar
altar.text:
[TODO:fr] Back in the promised land, you build stones.
The promise stands — despite you.
